```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
dogs_zurich = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a countplot to show the distribution of dog breeds
sns.set(font_scale=1.5)
plt.figure(figsize=(12,8))
plt.title('Distribution of Dog Breeds in Zurich')
sns.countplot(x='Rasse1Text', data=dogs_zurich)
plt.xlabel('Dog Breeds')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
